title: Germany at a Crossroads: AfD Surge and Economic Squeeze Test the Political… · 16 Sep
keywords: Germany, AfD, far-right, Saxony-Anhalt, Friedrich Merz, coalition, inflation, industrial production, eurozone, European Union, migration policy, cost of living, German economy, political instability, Bundesbank
notes: Germany's governing coalition faces a double challenge as a dramatic far-right electoral breakthrough rattles the political establishment and stubbornly elevated inflation continues to strain household budgets. The AfD's surge to around 44.5% in Saxony-Anhalt has sent shockwaves through Berlin, raising urgent questions about coalition stability and the durability of the mainstream consensus. Together, the political and economic pressures are testing Germany's capacity to govern at a moment when Europe's largest economy can least afford paralysis.
